compiled_state.title: Fix monthly/quarterly missing-ticket from silent-skip to exit-1 and name bootstrap script in errors
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What / Why

Story 9713 DD-4 requires calibration-rollup.yml to exit non-zero (CI failure, not silent skip) when any target tracking ticket is missing. Currently:

1. _cmd_monthly() and _cmd_quarterly() in calibration-report.sh emit a WARNING and return 0 (silent skip) when calibration-program-health ticket is missing
2. Error messages in mutation-append and churn-append say "run bootstrap first" but do not name the specific script dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh

## Files to Modify

- plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh:
  - _cmd_monthly(): change 'echo "WARNING: ... not found. Rollup not posted." && return 0' to 'echo "ERROR: ... not found. Run dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh to create it." && exit 1'
  - _cmd_quarterly(): same pattern
  - mutation-append and churn-append: update error messages to name dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh

## Story DD Coverage

- dd-4: calibration-rollup.yml exits non-zero when calibration-report.sh fails or when a target tracking ticket is missing

## Given / When / Then

Given calibration-report.sh monthly with no calibration-program-health ticket
When the command runs
Then exit code is 1 and error message names dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh

Given calibration-report.sh quarterly with no calibration-program-health ticket  
When the command runs
Then exit code is 1 and error message names dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh

## Testing Mode

RED — write tests first for the new exit-1 behavior, then implement

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: calibration-report.sh monthly exits 1 when calibration-program-health ticket absent
- AC2: calibration-report.sh quarterly exits 1 when calibration-program-health ticket absent
- AC3: Error messages in monthly, quarterly, mutation-append, and churn-append name dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh
- AC4: Tests cover AC1-AC3
